therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Dual T3/T4 hormone replacement to restore physiological thyroid hormone balance
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Normalization of energy metabolism and thyroid hormone-dependent cellular processes
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in weight, energy expenditure, and cholesterol levels

results.effect_size: Weight: combination therapy -0.76 kg vs single therapy +1.7 kg; Energy expenditure: combination therapy +25 cal/24h vs single therapy -39 cal/24h; Cholesterol: combination therapy -35 mg/dL vs single therapy +43 mg/dL
biomarker_changes: Cholesterol decreased by 35 mg/dL with combination therapy vs increased by 43 mg/dL with single therapy
subgroup_findings: Quality of life composite score improved more with combination therapy (45 points) vs single therapy (14.3 points)
Tiredness domain improved 36.7 points with combination vs 11.2 with single therapy
Cognitive domain improved 33.3 points with combination vs 14.3 with single therapy
results.dose_information: Levothyroxine sodium tablets and liothyronine sodium tablets for oral use

context.comparator: Levothyroxine monotherapy vs combination levothyroxine + liothyronine therapy vs placebo
